name: Transvoxel Algorithm
definition: A method for seamlessly stitching together neighboring triangle meshes generated from voxel data at differing resolutions so that level of detail (LOD) can be used with large voxel-based datasets such as volumetric terrain.
summary: The Transvoxel Algorithm seamlessly stitches triangle meshes from voxel data at differing resolutions using specialized transition cells to prevent surface discontinuities.
